2723	config ESPRESSIF_ETH_NRXDESC
2724		int "RX descriptor number"
2725		default 20
2726		---help---
2727			Number of DMA receive descriptors/buffers used by the EMAC.
2728			Each buffer is CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_ETH_DMA_BUFFER_SIZE bytes.
2729			The default of 20 provides headroom for TCP-style ACK bursts
2730			that arrive while the upper layer is busy submitting a TX burst
2731			(otherwise the EMAC asserts RX_BUFF_UNAVAILABLE and silently
2732			drops incoming frames, forcing TCP retransmissions).
2733	
2734	config ESPRESSIF_ETH_NTXDESC
2735		int "TX descriptor number"
2736		default 20
2737		---help---
2738			Number of DMA transmit descriptors/buffers used by the EMAC.
2739			With CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_ETH_DMA_BUFFER_SIZE=1600, each descriptor
2740			holds one Ethernet frame.  TCP send() bursts up to ~12 segments
2741			back-to-back; 20 descriptors gives ample headroom so that
2742			esp_eth_transmit() never returns ESP_ERR_NO_MEM mid-burst.
2743			If the ring is exhausted, frames are silently dropped and
2744			retransmissions happen via fast-retransmit/RTO, drastically
2745			degrading throughput.
2746	
2747	config ESPRESSIF_ETH_DMA_BUFFER_SIZE
2748		int "DMA buffer size (bytes)"
2749		default 1600
2750		range 256 1600
2751		---help---
2752			Size of each DMA buffer used by the EMAC (must match esp_eth's
2753			CONFIG_ETH_DMA_BUFFER_SIZE).  At the maximum 1600 bytes one
2754			buffer holds an entire 1518-byte Ethernet frame, so a typical
2755			TX uses exactly one descriptor.  Lower values cause the MAC DMA
2756			to chain multiple descriptors per frame, reducing the effective
2757			number of frames the ring can hold.
2758	
2759	config ESPRESSIF_ETH_TX_MAX_RETRIES
2760		int "TX submit retry budget"
2761		default 32
2762		range 1 256
2763		---help---
2764			Number of times emac_transmit() retries esp_eth_transmit() when
2765			the DMA TX descriptor ring is fully owned by hardware
2766			(ESP_ERR_NO_MEM).  Between attempts the driver yields the CPU
2767			via sched_yield() so that the RX worker (and any other peer at
2768			the same priority) can run while the EMAC DMA drains its TX
2769			descriptors in the background.  The default of 32 covers a
2770			full ring rotation under sustained TCP bursts while remaining
2771			bounded; increase if the network has very high latency between
2772			TX submissions and DMA descriptor recycling.
2773	
2774	config ESPRESSIF_ETH_PHY_ADDR
